title: Introducing the PQCNM Podcast, Travel Updates, and 'You Know Enough'
summary: President Hughes officially names his daily audio messages the 'Quezon City North Mission Podcast,' announcing an upcoming series on the science of habit creation and change. He provides historic updates on missionary travel movements between Australia and Africa before sharing comforting excerpts from Elder Neil L. Anderson's talk, 'You Know Enough,' to reinforce faith amid pandemic uncertainty.
